CreateIdleInstanceCuller.description_en: Creates an automatic stop policy for a specific Data Science Workshop (DSW) instance. When the conditions are met, the instance is automatically stopped. You can create only one automatic stop policy for an idle DSW instance. If the specific instance has an automatic stop policy, call DeleteIdleInstanceCuller to delete it first
CreateIdleInstanceCuller.description_zh: 创建指定实例的自动关机策略，满足条件时将自动停止DSW实例。一个DSW实例只支持创建一个闲置自动关机策略，如果指定实例已设定过闲置自动关机策略，请先调用DeleteIdleInstanceCuller将其删除

CreateInstance.description_en: Creates a DSW instance by calling CreateInstance

CreateInstanceShutdownTimer.description_en: Creates a scheduled stop task for an instance
CreateInstanceShutdownTimer.description_zh: 调用CreateInstanceShutdownTimer，创建实例定时关机任务

CreateSanityCheckTask.description_en: Submits an asynchronous health check task for a specified DSW instance. You must provide the check type (such as ssh) and the instance ID. The system immediately returns a unique task ID (TaskID), indicating that the task has been successfully queued. This operation does not block while waiting for the check result, making it suitable for scenarios that require a fast response. You can use the task ID to query the execution status and detailed results later
CreateSanityCheckTask.description_zh: 用于为指定的 DSW 实例提交一个异步健康检查任务。调用时需提供检查类型（如 ssh）和实例 ID，系统将立即返回一个唯一的任务 ID（TaskID），表示任务已成功入队。该接口不阻塞等待检查结果，适用于需要快速响应的场景，后续可通过任务 ID 查询执行状态与详细结果

DeleteIdleInstanceCuller.description_en: Deletes the automatic stop policy of an instance
DeleteIdleInstanceCuller.description_zh: 删除实例闲置关机策略

DeleteInstanceLabels.description_en: Delete tags from a Data Science Workshop (DSW) instance

DeleteInstanceShutdownTimer.description_en: Deletes a scheduled stop task of an instance
DeleteInstanceShutdownTimer.description_zh: 删除实例定时关机任务

DeleteTempFileTasks.description_en: Deletes one or more temporary file tasks

GetIdleInstanceCuller.description_en: Queries the information about an auto stop policy for a specific idle instance
GetIdleInstanceCuller.description_zh: 获取指定实例的闲置自动关机策略

GetInstance.description_en: Queries the details of a DSW instance

GetInstanceEvents.description_en: Retrieves system events for a DSW instance

GetInstanceMetrics.description_en: Queries the resource metrics of an instance
GetInstanceMetrics.description_zh: 获取实例运行的资源指标

GetInstanceShutdownTimer.description_en: Retrieves the details of a scheduled shutdown task for an instance
GetInstanceShutdownTimer.description_zh: 获取实例定时关机任务详情

GetInstanceSnapshot.description_en: Call the GetInstanceSnapshot operation to retrieve an instance snapshot
GetInstanceSnapshot.description_zh: 调用GetInstanceSnapshot，获取用户实例快照

GetLifecycle.description_en: Retrieves the lifecycle of an instance

GetMetrics.description_en: Retrieves the metrics for an instance

GetResourceGroupStatistics.description_en: A resource group provides a set of dedicated machine resources for Platform for AI (PAI). These resources run your PAI computing tasks and Data Science Workshop (DSW) instances. This operation retrieves statistics about the current and historical statuses of DSW instances in a specified resource group, such as the number of succeeded, failed, and stopped instances. These statistics help you understand your task history and optimize resource usage
GetResourceGroupStatistics.description_zh: 资源组是特定用户。在使用PAI产品前，预先购买的一组机器资源；这些机器资源专属于此客户，不会被其他客户分享。用户后续的PAI计算任务，或算法开发环境，将运行在这组机器上。此功能用于统计在指定资源组上，运行的 DSW 实例（算法开发环境）的当前和历史运行状态（成功，失败，停止等等），以帮助用户了解在资源组内运行任务的历史状态，更有效率的利用资源组内的机器资源

GetSanityCheckTask.description_en: Queries the status and results of a health check task. You can provide the task ID and check type to retrieve the task's progress, such as Pending, Executing, Completed, or Failed. The operation also returns the start and end times and a list of found issues. If you set verbose=true in the request, detailed analysis results for each checkpoint are returned. These details include the checkpoint name, description, result, and failure reason to help you diagnose problems
GetSanityCheckTask.description_zh: 用于查询指定健康检查任务的当前状态及结果。通过传入任务 ID 和检查类型，可获取任务的执行进度（如 Pending、Executing、Completed 或 Failed）、开始/结束时间、发现的问题列表（Issues）等信息。若请求时设置 verbose=true，还将返回每个检查项（checkpoint）的详细分析结果（CheckDetails），包括检查项名称、描述、结果及失败原因，便于精准定位问题

GetTempFile.description_en: Gets the details of a temporary file

GetTempFileTask.description_en: Retrieves the details of a temporary file task

GetToken.description_en: Retrieves the temporary authentication information for a specified DSW instance
GetToken.description_zh: 获取指定DSW实例的临时鉴权信息

GetUserConfig.description_en: You can call GetUserConfig to query user information

ListEcsSpecs.description_en: Query available ECS instance types with hardware specifications, pricing, and availability information for PAI-DSW notebooks

ListInstances.description_en: Queries a list of DSW instances

ListSystemLogs.description_en: Retrieves system logs. This API is deprecated and should not be used
ListSystemLogs.description_zh: 获取系统日志（待下线，请不要使用）

QueryAutoShutdownPolicies.description_en: Retrieves the auto shutdown policies for specified running instances
QueryAutoShutdownPolicies.description_zh: 获取指定运行中实例的自动关机策略信息

UpdateInstance.description_en: Updates the attributes of a DSW instance

UpdateInstanceLabels.description_en: Updates the tags of a Data Science Workshop (DSW) instance. If the tags do not exist, the system adds tags
UpdateInstanceLabels.description_zh: 更新DSW实例的标签，假如标签不存在则新增，假如标签存在则修改

UpdateTempFile.description_en: Updates the properties of a temporary file
